title: AI in Aviation: Transforming Safety and Sustainability
description: Artificial intelligence enhances aviation safety with predictive maintenance, air traffic optimization, and fuel-efficient flight.
short_description: A grounded look at AI in Aviation, covering what works, what wobbles, and what matters in practice.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A clear, no-hype briefing on AI in Aviation for operators, planners, analysts, product teams, and readers tracking mobility systems.
